items.title: Rational bridges stay rational bridges after base field extension
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file curves.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: Stability lemma (statement 6340-6343, proof 6344-6359): after any base field extension a rational bridge becomes a finite disjoint union of rational bridges - the proof runs through the separable product decomposition of the scalar extensions, the genus-0 property preserved by flat base change, and the componentwise degree-2 intersection; every step is justified and nothing is omitted. H2: separable algebra bookkeeping.
